description: Traffic Management — Intersection volume is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Real time data of traffic volume and occupancy of lanes at Brisbane City Council signalised intersections and approaches. Not all signalised traffic intersections within Brisbane are operated by Brisbane City Council. This dataset contains only the Brisbane City Council operated signalised traffic intersection data. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are intersection, road, traffic, transport, travel. The portal shows 19,405 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
